members.reason: The order approves and amends the highway-contractors code and conditionally stays only Article III section 6 upon an adverse Board finding. Its sixty-day review window ends neither the order nor the approved code. Incorporated code/effective-date text, affirmative stay/further-order evidence, whole-order cessation evidence and residual-effect evidence are absent; number-based machine negatives do not close pre-1937 or unnamed contrary actions.

clauses.reason: The complete held working text contains three operative components: adoption of the Board report/recommendations/findings, approval of Subchapter II-C and amendment of the previous Construction Industry Code approval, and a proviso permitting Board review of Article III section 6 within sixty days after the subchapter effective date with an immediate stay only upon the specified adverse finding pending further presidential order. The review window is neither a whole-order sunset nor evidence that the finding, stay, review or further order occurred. No supplied source establishes the first cessation or continuing legal predicate of all these components through the cutoff.

savings.reason: Approval and amendment of an industry code may have produced obligations or accrued consequences outside the face of this short approval order. The incorporated subchapter, underlying code, and any later disposition or savings rules are absent. The absence of an express savings clause in the held order cannot establish that no effects survived.

decision.research_rationale: Blocked on material substantive evidence, not merely on lack of an authenticated original. Both complete supplied text files were read and their text hashes match the selected pins. The Mabillon closing tag identifies 6988-A; the Photius body gives March 16, 1935 and corroborates the subject and commands, while Mabillon OCR misreads the signature date as 1986 and includes an April receipt stamp that is not the signing date. Photius text ends with an opening bracket despite its header claiming a closing tag on page 203, so its header alone does not verify the closing page. No page check is mandated by either selected evidence record, and no page examination is claimed. Prior research for this exact member reports no located prior version, review, rejection, status hold or canonical claim; its prompts remain unanswered. Zero-hit machine searches are bounded leads: the OFR catalog excludes the critical pre-1937 period; the current USC release stops before the legal cutoff and number-based searches do not reach unnamed industry-code actions, judicial holdings or administrative implementation. They cannot establish absence of earlier ends, amendment, renewal, a qualifying Board finding, or residual consequences. Source grades, original-replacement and quotation-recheck obligations remain unchanged.
